question: After PKU phrase-index nonmatches were correctly demoted to index-only evidence, is there a directly documented physical-journal route to the 2008(03) issue that could support lawful page inspection or copying of pp.121-129?
answer: Yes, at the holding/access-route level. The National Diet Library first-party catalog records the paper serial 中國典籍與文化 under call number Z21-AC41 / NDLBibID a0000052718 with holdings from 1994 issue 1 (total 8) through 2018 issue 4 (total 107), a span that covers 2008 issue 3. The exact 2008(3) child-record/item identifier has not yet been resolved in this batch, so no issue-level material ID or copy eligibility is claimed. CiNii NCID AA1225301X independently lists multiple Japanese university holdings whose stated ranges include 2008, including Gakushuin, Kyoto University Institute for Research in Humanities, Takushoku, University of Tokyo Institute for Advanced Studies on Asia, Bukkyo University and Waseda. These are physical-access locators only; none has been used to inspect pp.121-129. NDL's official help documents paid remote copying for some NDL-tagged materials and an article-location investigation service for registered individual users, but using those services requires an account/action boundary and exact target eligibility has not been established. No login, copy request, ILL request, fee or purchase was performed.
